## Review result: incomplete—event evidence unavailable

I verified the work order and September Pending Close timestamp, but **cannot determine whether a cost event was created afterward** from the records available to my role.

| Requested item | Verified result |
|---|---|
| Manufacturing order | **MO-25-09-1070** |
| Work order ID | **WO-2025-09-004** |
| Operation / product | Modine Racine–Dekoven / Cooler Plate Pack |
| Cost period | **Sep-25**, `PER-COST-2025-09` |
| Exact Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Source transaction ID | Unavailable |
| Event amount | Unavailable |
| Exact event-created time | Unavailable |
| Minutes after Pending Close | Cannot calculate without the event-created time |
| Recorded accounting status | Unavailable |
| Status consistent with Oracle policy? | Cannot determine without the event type, timing, and recorded status |

The accessible records contain work orders and cost periods, but **no cost-event rows**. The supporting-record service returned “supporting records not staged” on repeated attempts. Its metadata restricts access to the records-custodian role; I did not access the restricted package. This evidence gap **does not establish that no late event occurred**. The Pending Close timestamp has no timezone offset in the source.

### Oracle policy

Oracle’s *Supply Chain Cost Management 26B*, “Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting” (PDF page 233; printed page 225), states that new transactions created after Pending Close and relating to that or an earlier period are not staged or processed until the period is closed or reopened. Transactions entered beforehand continue processing. **Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions** that continue processing after Pending Close.

Accordingly, a newly created, non-exempt transaction should be held during Pending Close. I cannot assess this event’s recorded status without its underlying record.

No database records were changed. The partial report was submitted with status **`needs_evidence`**, and the audit result and provenance were saved to `/cache/work/worker_45865eba7651/audit-report.json`.
